question: A reduction of 15% in the price of sugar enables Aruna Rai to buy 6 kg more for Rs. 272. The reduced price of sugar per kg is:
solution:
**Given:**

A price of reduction of sugar = 15%

Aruna Rai buy 6 kg more = Rs. 272

**Calculation:**

According to the question

A price of reduction of sugar = 15% = (15/100) = 3/20

Now,

Cost of 6 kg sugar = Rs. 272

Then,

Cost of 1 kg sugar = Rs. (272/6) kg

Now,

The reduced price of sugar = Rs. (272/6 × 3/20)

⇒ Rs. (136/20)

⇒ Rs. 6.80

**∴ The reduced price of sugar per kg is Rs. 6.80**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** According to Question,

15% reduction in Sugar Price = 6 Kg more sugar

If 100% reduction in Sugar Price = (6/15) × 100 = 40 Kg

It means that Aruna previously bought sugar quantity = 40 - 6 = 34 kg

Now, The reduced price of sugar = 272/40

⇒ Rs. 6.80 per kg.

∴ The reduced price of sugar per kg is Rs. 6.80
